description: This file contains test scripts for the web application's recipe browsing functionality, using the Test2 and Test::Coocook modules to perform HTTP requests and verify responses.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and checks for a successful response.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link with specified link text and verifies the navigation.

methods.name: base_is
methods.description: Checks that the current base URL matches the expected URL.

methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL.
